module rtlpp_05561 (
    input wire clk_in,
    input wire data_in,
    input wire scan_select_in,
    input wire latch_enable_in,
    output wire clk_out,
    output wire data_out,
    output wire scan_select_out,
    output wire latch_enable_out
    );

    wire clk;
    wire data_out_i;
    
    assign clk = clk_in;
    assign clk_out = clk;
    assign scan_select_out = scan_select_in;
    assign latch_enable_out = latch_enable_in;

    parameter NUM_IOS = 8;

    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_out;   
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_in;    
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_in;  
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_out; 

    assign scan_data_in = {scan_data_out[NUM_IOS-2:0], data_in};

    reg data_out_i_reg;
    always @(negedge clk) begin
        data_out_i_reg <= scan_data_out[NUM_IOS-1];
    end
    assign data_out_i = data_out_i_reg;

    `ifndef FORMAL
    `ifndef FORMAL_COMPAT
    reg [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_out_reg;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (scan_select_in) begin
            scan_data_out_reg <= module_data_out;
        end else begin
            scan_data_out_reg <= scan_data_in;
        end
    end
    assign scan_data_out = scan_data_out_reg;

    reg [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_in_reg;
    always @(posedge latch_enable_in) begin
        module_data_in_reg <= scan_data_out;
    end
    assign module_data_in = module_data_in_reg;
    `endif
    `endif

    // Example implementation of user_module_341542971476279892
    // This should be replaced with the actual logic of the user module.
    // Placeholder logic is given below.
    reg [NUM_IOS-1:0] user_module_data_out;
    always @(*) begin
        user_module_data_out = module_data_in; // Direct pass-through for example
    end
    assign module_data_out = user_module_data_out;
    
endmodule
